notes: §1989:A.2.22.2 prints "FUNCTION LOWER-CASE ( argument-1 )": exactly one argument in parentheses. The catalog row (Build) admits LOWER-CASE at 85 with one argument, and BindFunctionResult's arity check refuses none, empty parentheses and two (COBOL1504). The LOCALE phrase that §2023:15.57.2 adds is found by HasLocalePhrase and refused at 85 by BindCaseFunctionWithLocale's construct check (COBOL0900); where the program declares a data item named LOCALE, KeywordWordOf reads the word as an operand and the reference is refused for two arguments. Probed at 85: the format with and without spaces and with a reference modifier is accepted; LOCALE with and without a locale-name, the form without parentheses and the name without FUNCTION are refused. The witness runs the format once.

next.reason: 1985: "FUNCTION LOWER-CASE ( argument-1 )"; 2023: "FUNCTION LOWER-CASE ( argument-1 [ LOCALE locale-name-1 ] )". 2023 keeps the 1985 format and adds an optional LOCALE locale-name-1 phrase, so it accepts programs the 1985 format refuses.
